data.one_liner: A draggable floating chat icon button that displays messages on the screen.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that displays a draggable floating chat button over a background view. It allows showing and hiding messages, with options for custom colors, icons, and display parameters such as delay and frequency.
use_when: You need a draggable chat or support button on your screen.
You want to display automated pop-up messages next to a floating icon.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured chat interface or messaging backend client.
You require complex routing or state management integration beyond simple UI widgets.
strengths: Customizable colors, icons, and message widgets.
Supports delayed and randomized message display.
weaknesses: Limited to a floating chat button use case.
Lacks built-in chat UI message history or conversation views.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to dependencies and place the widget inside a Scaffold body or Stack.
